heading: Frequently Asked Questions About Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu (BJJ) in LOCATION

faqs.question: Is the BJJ academy located in LOCATION?
faqs.answer: Kando Martial Arts is located in the heart of the Knox area in Boronia, within the City of Knox, just minutes from LOCATION and conveniently situated off Lewis Road near Knox City Shopping Centre.

faqs.question: Do I need prior experience to start Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu?
faqs.answer: No prior experience is required. Our Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu classes are suitable for complete beginners as well as experienced practitioners, with instructors guiding you step by step.

faqs.question: What age can children start Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu?
faqs.answer: Children can start Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu from around 7 years old. Our kids BJJ program focuses on safety, confidence, coordination, and age-appropriate grappling skills.

faqs.question: How often should I attend BJJ classes?
faqs.answer: For best results, we recommend training Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu 2 times per week. However, our flexible timetable allows students in LOCATION to train at a pace that suits their lifestyle.

faqs.question: What should I wear to my first BJJ class?
faqs.answer: For your first Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu class, comfortable athletic clothing is fine. If you continue training, you’ll need a BJJ gi, which we can help you organise.

faqs.question: Is Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu safe for kids?
faqs.answer: Yes. Safety is a top priority in our kids BJJ classes. All training is closely supervised by qualified instructors, with techniques tailored to each age group.

faqs.question: Are there beginner BJJ classes available in LOCATION?
faqs.answer: Yes, we offer beginner-friendly Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu classes in Boronia for both children and adults, making it easy to start with no previous martial arts experience.

faqs.question: What benefits does Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu offer for kids in LOCATION?
faqs.answer: Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu helps children in LOCATION develop confidence, problem-solving skills, discipline, fitness, and effective self-defence abilities in a fun and supportive environment.

faqs.question: Do you offer Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu classes for adults in LOCATION?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our adult BJJ classes in Boronia focus on practical self-defence, fitness, stress relief, and technical skill development, suitable for all fitness levels.

faqs.question: How do I book a trial Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu class in LOCATION?
faqs.answer: Booking a trial Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu class in our dojo in Boronia is simple. Contact us through our website or give us a call, and our friendly team will help you get started.
